question: By how many percentage points did acid washing lower the ash content (Aad) of the lignite used for co-pyrolysis with sawdust, and by what share of its original value?
expect: 7.02 to 1.48: 5.54 points, about 79% of the original (78.9%) (Table 1)
rendered:
The ash content (Aad) of the lignite coal (LC, original) was 7.02 wt/%. 
The ash content (Aad) of the acid-washed lignite coal (LC) was 1.48 wt/%. 

The difference between the two ash contents is 7.02 - 1.48 = 5.54 wt/%. 

Acid washing lowered the ash content of the lignite by 5.54 wt/%.
